method: Before Phase 2.2F production edits, hash-verified the Phase 2.2E bridge and replayed the seven exact original Gemma extractions in 21 isolated SQLite stores plus the exact C RAM seed in one separate rules store. No new model inference. Each store was checked read-only with query_only and quick_check. Canonical values in intended_canonical_relation are fixture expectations. Model output only nominated evidence and category.

out_of_order_baseline.newer: My preference has changed: for my own coffee, I now prefer it without sugar.
out_of_order_baseline.older: For my own afternoon coffee, I prefer it with sugar.
out_of_order_baseline.cause: The later source had first-person ownership, but the old verbal classifier recognized I prefer and did not recognize the first-person subject with the inserted adverb now. The named coffee and pronominal object never produced a native preference. A done job with zero memories gave the rowid guard no newer relation for coffee_sugar.
